it is possible to calculate limits, discovery and cut optimizations with a high degree of precision and in a reasonable amount of time for a Poisson signal process with uncertainties in signal efficiency, background, and signal strength.
it is possible to implement a general and flexible framework for the calculation of confidence intervals in C++, Python and ROOT.
